newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bidding for Colombia railroads opens Nov. 28.
newsitem.headline: Bidding for Colombia railroads opens Nov. 28.

text.p: Bidding for the first stretch of Colombia's decrepit railroad to be put out to private concession opens Nov. 28, a spokesman for the state railway Ferrovias said Wednesday.

The 940-mile (1,500 km) Atlantic line, which links the center of the country to the Caribbean coastal ports, is the first to come under the gavel. The 405-mile (650 km) Pacific line is scheduled to come up for sale next spring.
Colombia's railway network is more than 1,900 miles (3,000 km) long but 40 percent of that has fallen into disrepair.
